conbody.p: To change the Warning Methods settings while the vehicle is ON, tap SetupVehicleDriver AssistanceWarning Methods on the infotainment system screen. You can change the following settings:

li.p: Warning Volume: Adjusts the volume of the warning sound.
Haptic Warning: Turns ON the steering wheel vibration warning.
Driving Safety Priority: Lowers all other audio volumes when the Driving Safety system sounds a warning.
Lane Safety Warning Sound: You can turn on or off the Lane Safety warning sound when the Haptic warning is on.
Your Warning Methods settings may apply to the Warning Methods of other driver assistance systems.
Warning Methods maintain their last settings when you turn OFF and restart the vehicle.
The Warning Methods setting menu may not be available on all vehicles.
The Lane Safety Warning sound can be adjusted only when the steering wheel vibration warning is enabled.

note.p: When connecting a trailer or carrier, set the trailer or carrier menu (if equipped). If the driver manually sets the menu or the trailer or carrier connection is automatically recognized through genuine parts, the functions of the driver assistance system may be limited. Please refer to and always drive with caution.
